sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, 'Smash the Ants' is a simple yet addictive game that revolves around keeping the ants from escaping the screen. The key to success lies in your ability to time your attacks perfectly and make strategic decisions to stay ahead of the pack.

One of the most challenging aspects of the game is the constantly changing speed and pattern of the ants. As you progress through the levels, the ants will become faster, and the screen will start to fill up with more and more of them. This requires you to be quick on your feet and make rapid decisions to stay in control.
